incidents-bot: P0 alert — surge of 5xxs on /v1/generate (customer: AcmeRetail). 5xx rate jumped to 18% over last 3m. Root ts 1714012345. Paging oncall.
amanda (oncall-eng): seeing it, joining. which codepath is failing? quick check of routes?
raj (sre): logs show repeated fallback responses from routing service: fallback to variant 'gen-instruct-v2' for requests that should go to 'embed-lite-v1'. downstream handlers expect embeddings array but getting text => 500s. sample error: `TypeError: expected list, got string` in embed-ingest-handler.
amanda (oncall-eng): oh. that sounds exactly like a pinned model/variant mismatch. simon, any deployment/rollout changes in the last hour?
simon (modelops): I pushed a variant pin for /internal/embeds/online to 'gen-instruct-v2' earlier (was testing local eval) but I thought I targeted internal-test only. config diff that went live:

```
routes:
  - path: /internal/embeds/online
    pinned_variant: gen-instruct-v2
    fallback_policy: match-by-capability
```

should have been pinned to embed-lite-v1. my bad — I pushed to prod namespace by mistake.

:sweat: I'm on it.
luis (infra): routing-service picked that up and because capability check matched (both advertise 'text' optional), the smart router decided gen-instruct-v2 is compatible and routed. but downstream embed handler assumed 'embeddings' output shape.
ellie (cs): several customer requests started failing ~ 12:07 PST; Acme reported timeouts and 500s on their embed ingestion. they're on a paid plan — contacted them with acknowledgement.
amanda (oncall-eng): immediate mitigation options: 1) unpin route so router can pick embed variant, 2) add a temporary routing override to prefer embedding-capable backends, 3) rollback simon's change. Which is fastest?
raj (sre): fastest is unpin or rollback. simon, can you clear the pin now? I'll also add a routing override until we confirm.
simon (modelops): running rollback now:

```
# rollback pin
redwoodctl pins clear --route /internal/embeds/online --env prod
```

(simon runs command)

simon (modelops): command succeeded, pin cleared. router metrics show drop in fallback-to-gen after ~20s.
luis (infra): I'm pushing a temporary policy tweak to prefer variants with 'output:embeddings' capability for this route.

```
redwoodctl routing update --route /internal/embeds/online --policy prefer-capability:embeddings --brief
```

luis (infra): applied. observing request traces — responses now going to embed-lite-v1. 5xx rate trending down from 18% -> 2% in last minute.
amanda (oncall-eng): Ellie's ping to Acme: informed them we identified mis-pinned variant and applied mitigation; asking for any residual failures and requesting logs. Ellie, please offer credit for the disruption and timeline.
ellie (cs): pinged. they replied they saw errors stop at 12:11 PST. requested root cause timeline. I offered a 2% credit and a postmortem when available.
raj (sre): verifying downstream handler errors clearing. stack traces for the prior 5xxs point to bad shape assumptions; no data corruption expected. will keep monitoring for 30m then close.
simon (modelops): taking action items: 1) add gating to pin pushes so prod namespace requires two approvals, 2) add a linting check to prevent pinning a gen variant to embed routes (capability mismatch check). I'll file the change and start the PR.
amanda (oncall-eng): oncall handoff note: I'm going offline at 12:30 PST, leaving this in a watch state. raj, please own until end of hour. simon, luis, ellie — follow-ups as discussed.

-- status update at 1714012460 --
raj (sre): 5xx rate stable at ~1.6%, traces show consistent embedding outputs now. no new errors in last 5m. OEM customer impact: ~450 requests failed during window, mostly retries handled upstream.

-- post-incident planning --
amanda (oncall-eng): postmortem items: 1) human error led to wrong pin in prod, 2) routing service capability matcher was permissive and allowed genotype->embed routing, 3) lack of pin approval gate, 4) incident communication and CS handling worked.

amanda (oncall-eng): immediate follow-ups (owners): simon (modelops) — approval gate + CI lint; luis (infra) — tighten capability matcher to require explicit capability intersection when route expects embeddings; raj (sre) — add alert for sudden capability-mismatched fallbacks; ellie (cs) — finalize customer credits and timeline.
simon (modelops): filing PR for pin-approval and lint. ETA EOD. will also add a small test that simulates embedding route and rejects non-embedding variants at pin time.
luis (infra): will change router to prefer stricter capability checks (non-breaking toggle) — targeting a safe rollout tomorrow.
raj (sre): adding an alert rule: increase in 'fallback_to_variant' rate for routes that declare output_shape != variant.output_shape. watcher will page if > 5% for 5m.
ellie (cs): will send official incident summary to Acme and coordinate credits.
amanda (oncall-eng): closing the page; monitoring for 1h then we'll mark resolved. great quick work everyone, and thanks for the speedy rollback.

incidents-bot: Incident resolved (mitigation applied). Marking P0 -> P1 watch. Reference: 1714012345.
